entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Jolrael, called the empress of beasts, speaks of Dominaria's system of life with its prey and predators.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane whose wonders include a system of life with prey and predators.

relations.note: Speaks of Dominaria's wonders and its system of life
relations.quote: "We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
